key_rationale: With headline CPI inflation at 7.01% persistently breaching the upper tolerance limit, monetary policy must act decisively to prevent the unanchoring of inflation expectations. Given the positive output gap of 0.40% and the need to address high core inflation of 6.20% amidst global spillovers, a front-loaded increase of 50 basis points is necessary to align the repo rate with the objective of durable price stability.
